name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
description: Direct income support scheme providing ₹6000 per year to eligible farmers in three installments.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers with cultivable landholding
appProcess: Online registration through PM-Kisan portal or CSC centers

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: Crop insurance scheme providing financial support against crop failure due to natural calamities.
eligibility: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers
benefits: Insurance coverage for crop loss due to drought, flood, pests
appProcess: Apply through bank, insurance agents, or CSC centers

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
description: Short-term credit support for farmers to meet agricultural and allied needs.
appProcess: Apply through banks or cooperative societies

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Provides soil health analysis and recommendations to improve crop productivity.
benefits: Free soil testing and fertilizer recommendations
appProcess: Through agriculture department or local soil testing labs

name: Maharashtra Seed Subsidy Scheme
description: Subsidy on certified seeds for farmers in Maharashtra to improve crop yield.
benefits: Up to 50% subsidy on certified seeds

name: Micro Irrigation Scheme Maharashtra
description: Financial assistance for drip and sprinkler irrigation systems.
eligibility: Farmers with agricultural land in Maharashtra
benefits: Up to 55% subsidy on irrigation systems
appProcess: Apply via state agriculture department portal

name: PM-KUSUM Scheme
description: Promotes solar energy use in agriculture for irrigation pumps.
benefits: Subsidy on solar pumps and solar power plants
appProcess: Apply through state renewable energy agencies

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund
description: Financial support for post-harvest infrastructure and community farming assets.
benefits: Low-interest loans with subsidy on interest
appProcess: Apply via banks and NABARD-linked institutions
